title: Bounded exact category/representation evidence, followed by separate semantic specialist decisions.
owner: root-coordinated f3 evidence researcher, then fresh dedicated semantic reconciler
resolution:
Open: nonblocking to architecture, mandatory before the affected integration. Complete small code/category snapshots and seven Sakila exceptions; no bulk economic import; no blanket bridge. Expected payoff: Unlock S1/W1, S4 exposure and actual additional demos.

Phase3 root-acceptance binding: remains OPEN and blocks phases4/5/6 completion for the affected selected scenario. It does not block work on unrelated accepted paths. Closure requires dedicated semantic decisions and source/legal/coverage evidence for the scoped integration, or an explicit root-reviewed narrower portfolio with retained rejected/deferred paths. A source observation alone cannot close this question. W1 already accepted provider-reference paths remain separate; country→economy/Ember and additional demo bridges apply to W2/full market scenarios. Landed f3 observations are evidence inputs, not semantic acceptance.
